recipe.name: Til Gud Martini
recipe.description: A rich and earthy cocktail blending nutty sesame-infused whiskey with complex jaggery syrup and bold espresso.
steps: Add sesame whiskey, jaggery syrup, and freshly brewed coffee to a cocktail shaker.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake vigorously for 15 seconds to create a silky foam.
Double strain the mixture into a chilled martini glass.
recipe.garnish: A floating pinch of toasted sesame seeds
recipe.serving: Serve well-chilled with a velvety layer of coffee foam on top.
